title: Returned-Payment Hold on Directed Payments — Crestline Credit Card
content:
On a Crestline Credit Card account, a returned-payment hold keeps back a share of the amount reaching the plan a cardholder directs a payment to, for a few days: when two or more payments were returned unpaid fewer than 6 whole months before today, 0.25 is added to the held share; when exactly one was, 0.15 is added; otherwise nothing is added.

**Records read:** returned payment entries on the card ledger posted fewer than 6 whole months before today.

| Payments returned unpaid in that time | Added to the held share |
|---|---|
| two or more | 0.25 (25 percent of the amount reaching the plan) |
| exactly one | 0.15 (15 percent) |
| none | nothing |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- Payments returned 2 and 5 months ago: 0.25; with nothing else held, 50.00 USD of 200.00 USD reaching the plan is kept back.
- One payment returned 4 months ago and another 7 months ago: only one is within 6 months; 0.15.
- A single return exactly 6 whole months ago is outside the count: nothing.
